summary.intent: Complete GSD phases 42-44 of the CipherBox v1.1 milestone (gap-closure phases from a UAT audit): discuss, plan, and execute API unpin integrity, FUSE write durability, and IPNS conflict handling.
summary.outcome: Phases 42 and 43 fully closed (all plans executed, verified, and committed); Phase 44 planned and wave-1 execution started (44-01 complete, waves 2+ pending). Project advanced from 26/29 to 28/29 phases complete.

repo: Kubo runs with the `server` profile (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72) and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly — it keeps full DHT participation, so every pinned CID has a public provider record. The server profile only disables local-network discovery.

The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) was JWT-only with open signup and never read req.user, making any account holder able to destroy any CID by harvesting DHT provider records or IPNS resolution. Fixed via guardedUnpin with advisory lock + refcount + outbox.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids (shared-write.ts:450) without calling unpin — there is no legitimate cross-user unpin path in the codebase.
The upload compensation path at ipfs.controller.ts:122 fires a global pin/rm on a dedup-shared CID, which was a hidden cross-tenant data-destruction vector now rerouted through guardedUnpin.
GSD auto-manages per-phase feat/ branches; main stays untouched. Planning/execution artifacts commit to the phase branch, not main.

pnpm test flag gotcha: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` silently breaks (pnpm inserts `--`, jest treats the flag as a positional regex). Correct form: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`
gsd commit helper can return `committed: false` as a false negative even when the commit actually landed. Always verify with `git log --oneline -1`, never blind-retry.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun and abort the entire run. Use a reduced manifest containing only remaining unmerged entries.
cleanup-wave resolves repo root from cwd — running it from inside a worktree causes false base_mismatch failures. Always run from the repo root.
Node_modules symlinks and .husky/_ untracked dirs block worktree merges; rm them before cleanup-wave.

Prettier had no .prettierignore so it was mangling .planning/ YAML frontmatter (breaking table pipes, reformatting markdown). Created .prettierignore to exclude .planning/, .claude/agents/gsd-*.md, .claude/commands/gsd/, and related GSD directories.

WinFsp cross-compilation (cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp) always fails on macOS due to pre-existing windows-future/winfsp-sys issues unrelated to project code; use cargo check for correctness validation.
1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true in Bash tool calls. Signing failures often need the 1Password app restarted. Never bypass with --no-gpg-sign.
Nest `build` side-effect reformats openapi.json (formatting-only, ~564 lines); restore with `git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json` before merging worktrees to avoid noise in diffs.
The FUSE handle_release journal ordering is load-bearing: journal.put → handle.cleanup → reply.ok → spawn_upload → journal.remove-on-success. Reversing any step creates a crash window.

code.finding: Upload compensation path fired a raw pin/rm on a content-addressed CID that could be shared across users; rerouted through guardedUnpin to get the ownership/refcount check.

guardedUnpin added: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → transactional row-delete + refcount → pending_unpins outbox insert if last reference → Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort. Cross-user attempts increment cipherbox_unpin_cross_user_attempts_total and return silent 2XX.
PendingUnpin added to forFeature; local IPFS_PROVIDER useFactory added to break a circular import that would occur if IpfsModule were imported.
handle_mkdir: journal.put called inside closure before reply.entry; conflict arm now sends FsEvent::MkdirConflict instead of warn-only; journal entry cleared only on successful parent-publish.

handle_release fsync-before-ack ordering enforced: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove-on-success(943). CR-04 fix: reply.error(EIO) on journal fsync failure prevents OS ack after failure.

Full rewrite: JournalOp enum, JournalEntryStatus, JournalEntry, WriteQueue with put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay. Fsync-before-ack is the core durability guarantee.

UploadSpawnParams type corrections (ApiClient, Handle, PublishCoordinator); journal entry carried into spawn for record_failure; removal gated on per-file IPNS publish success. CR-08: spawn_journal.remove must NOT be called from background thread — replay on next mount is the authoritative cleanup.
Kubo v0.40 runs with `server` profile AND swarm port 4001 exposed publicly. Server profile only disables LAN discovery, not DHT participation — all pinned CIDs are advertised to public DHT crawlers.

mergeChildren: pure three-way merge for IPNS folder conflict resolution. 10 permutations tested (add/add, remove/remove, add/remove conflicts). baseChildren param required — callers must fetch the base version before calling.

BullMQ WorkerHost with drainPendingUnpins (calls provider, not raw Kubo; error-isolates per row; updates gauge) and runDriftReport (NDJSON parse of pin ls output, strictly read-only — zero .delete( calls in drift path).

workflow: Worktree execution: spawn agents with isolation='worktree' off a captured base SHA; record each in a manifest JSON; run cleanup-wave --manifest after all wave executors complete; never run cleanup-wave from inside a worktree directory.
Post-merge gate must be targeted: build the affected package + run only the test suites touched by the wave. Full monorepo test suites exhaust RAM in subagents.
TDD RED/GREEN gate verification: check git log for the RED commit (failing tests) coming strictly before the GREEN commit (implementation). Commit SHAs in SUMMARY.md are the audit trail.

Migration checkpoints under --auto: run an independent verification query (to_regclass for schema objects) to auto-approve; the live-DB confirmation is more reliable than trusting the migration runner output alone.

Planner socket errors mid-run can be recovered without replanning: verify which PLAN.md files are complete on disk (check file size and tail), then spawn a continuation planner for the remaining plan numbers only.

Decision coverage gates use mechanical grep for literal D-NN: citations in plan must_haves sections. Missing a citation causes gate failure even if the decision is conceptually covered — add explicit truth lines.

Phase rebasing: after completing a dependency phase, rebase the next phase's branch (which has CONTEXT/DISCUSSION-LOG commits) onto the completed branch so it inherits the full implementation history.
GSD verifier produces VERIFICATION.md; items marked human_needed require a UAT.md file listing the runtime test steps. Auto-verifiable items can be confirmed inline via DB queries or build checks.
openapi.json formatting drift: always restore it before merging worktrees if a wave plan runs api:generate, or the merge introduces a 500-line formatting-only diff that pollutes code review.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures required the user to restart the 1Password app mid-session; all subsequent git commits needed dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true to get signed commits through.
Planner agent socket error after writing plans 01-03 required manual filesystem recovery: verify complete files, spawn continuation planner for remaining plans.
gsd commit helper false negatives (returns committed: false when commit landed) caused redundant retry logic and confusion; requires always verifying with git log.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent and aborts on the first blocked entry; required writing reduced manifests with only unmerged entries for each retry.
Running cleanup-wave from inside a worktree cwd causes false base_mismatch errors; had to re-run from repo root.
Node_modules and .husky/_ untracked dirs inside worktrees blocked merge operations; required manual rm before cleanup.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD in a completed-but-uncommitted state; required manual `git commit --no-edit` to conclude, then manual worktree remove + branch -D.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side-effects required `git checkout --` restore before each wave merge to avoid noise.
pnpm/jest flag passing silently breaks testPathPattern filtering; discovered only after seeing incorrect test results.

prettier mangling .planning/ YAML frontmatter (breaking table pipes) was root-caused to missing .prettierignore; also broke a regex pipe in VALIDATION.md table that appeared as a table column separator.
Accidental user text input ('touring wyatt web bossy') mid-execution required interruption handling and resumption.
Two session limit hits interrupted running agents; required quota-aware recovery and re-dispatch of in-progress executors.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed due to missing literal citation in plan must_haves even though the decision was conceptually addressed; required adding explicit truth line.
zsh multi-glob rm (rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules) aborts entirely if any glob misses; requires single explicit paths.
open_items: Phase 44 execution incomplete: only wave-1 (44-01 ConflictError + mergeChildren) done; waves 2+ (folder conflict retry loop, file CAS latest-wins, TS caller sweep) still pending.
Phase 42 SECURITY.md missing — security gate flagged it; /gsd:secure-phase 42 needs to be run.
Phase 43 has 4 runtime UAT items in 43-UAT.md requiring human testing: crash-recovery journal replay on remount, MkdirConflict FsEvent re-arm, WriteParked tray notification, WinFsp replay on mount.
Pending-uploads UI (tray/sidebar showing queued writes with status counts) deferred to a future milestone; noted in 43-CONTEXT.md deferred ideas.
BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring deferred: advisory-row semantics are correct server-side but the BYO unpin path is still broken end-to-end for clients.
Writable-share prunedCids leak: share recipients see CIDs they should no longer access after revocation; deferred from phase 42 scope.
Rust FUSE parity for phase 44 IPNS conflict handling deferred: three-way merge and ConflictError are TypeScript-only; Rust SDK has no equivalent yet.
Phase 43 code review (43-REVIEW.md) was done only on the original 4 plans; the 4 gap-closure plans (43-05 through 43-08) were not re-reviewed.
Backfill script (scripts/backfill-pinned-cids.ts) for phase 42 is implemented but not yet run against production to repair historical quota orphans.
Drift report (runDriftReport in pending-unpin.processor.ts) is read-only detect-only; no remediation workflow exists yet for pins found in Kubo but absent from pinned_cids.
